gbm_population_evidence.quote: Patient must have histologically confirmed newly diagnosed glioblastoma (GBM, world health organization (WHO) grade IV).

candidate_evidence.quote: A Phase I/II Open Label Study to Assess Safety and Preliminary Evidence of a Therapeutic Effect of Azeliragon Combined With Conventional Concurrent Radiation and Temozolomide in Patients With Newly Diagnosed Glioblastoma

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Azeliragon and Chemoradiotherapy in Newly Diagnosed Glioblastoma

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: S100A9 expression levels: Expression levels of the S100A9 molecular biomarker in blood samples from patients. Samples will be taken at baseline, Week 10 and after progression

agents.agent_name_registered: Azeliragon 5 mg; Azeliragon 10 mg; Azeliragon 20 mg

role_evidence.quote: This is an open label study to determine the safety and preliminary evidence of a therapeutic effect of azeliragon in patients with newly diagnosed glioblastoma receiving concurrent radiation and temozolomide.

agents.drug_class_hint: investigational oral RAGE (receptor for advanced glycation end products) antagonist

role_evidence.quote: plus concomitant daily temozolomide (TMZ; 75 mg/m2/day, 7 days/week from the first to the last day of radiotherapy), followed by six cycles of adjuvant TMZ

source_quote.quote: Note: Patients should be isocitrate dehydrogenase (IDH) wild type diagnosed locally
The local O-6-Methylguanine-DNA Methyltransferase (MGMT) report determination should be available and should be uploaded to the electronic case report form (eCRF).
Expression levels of the S100A9 molecular biomarker in blood samples from patients.

coder_notes: Three registered interventions (azeliragon 5, 10, 20 mg dose levels) collapsed into one agent row. Temozolomide is not a registered intervention but every patient receives it with radiotherapy (Stupp backbone), so listed as soc_backbone. MGMT report must be available at entry but no MGMT status is required, so coded exploratory_correlative rather than eligibility. S100A9 (a RAGE ligand) is measured in blood as a secondary outcome; the record does not link it to azeliragon or its target, hence target_engagement_planned unclear and the S100A9 row not candidate-matched; S100A9 is a blood marker, possibly not a tumour biomarker. Corticosteroids mentioned only in eligibility, not listed.
